{"disposition":"return_to_vendor","reasoning":"INV-1013 is returned because F1 is a reject-severity total mismatch: line items sum to $21,040.00 plus tax of $1,472.80 equals $22,512.80, but the invoice total is $22,562.80, a $50.00 gap with shipping blank. F2, F3, and F4 are reject-severity quantity exceptions: WidgetA is billed for 22 units against 15 in stock, WidgetB for 18 against 10, and GadgetX for 9 against 5. These findings can be corrected and resubmitted and are not grounds to void the invoice.","vendor_reply":"Hello Atlas Industrial Supply billing team,

We cannot process invoice INV-1013 as submitted and are returning it so you can correct and resubmit it.

The line items sum to $21,040.00 and tax is $1,472.80, which equals $22,512.80, but the invoice total is $22,562.80. Shipping is blank. Please make the total equal the sum of the line items, tax, and any shipping. If the $50.00 difference is a shipping or expedite charge, itemize it; otherwise remove it so the total is $22,512.80, or revise the lines and tax so they reconcile to the stated total.

The billed quantities also exceed what we can accept: WidgetA is billed for 22 units across three lines, WidgetB for 18 units across two lines, and GadgetX for 9 units across three lines. Please reduce those quantities to amounts we can accept and send a corrected invoice.

Thank you."}
message.reasoning_content:
Closing out the rejected invoice.

The invoice should be dispositioned as return_to_vendor. The wrong totals and quantities exceeding stock are eligible for vendor correction.

The audit log will cite the finding IDs. The vendor email will request corrections without revealing internal stock levels.

The vendor email will cite the exact invoice quantities and total mismatch figures. It will request reductions to acceptable levels without referencing internal stock.

The total mismatch is exactly $50. The corrected invoice must equal lines plus tax plus any shipping, with shipping itemized if it is the cause.

For quantities, the email will cite the billed amounts per SKU without stating our stock levels.

The vendor email body is drafted. It cites the exact line-item and tax totals, the $50 total mismatch, and requests correction of the total or itemization of any shipping charge.
